label: Knowledge Base RAG System
summary: A complete per-base RAG pipeline in the Electron main process: knowledge bases are created in the main SQLite DB (knowledgeBaseTable/knowledgeItemTable), source files/URLs/notes are copied into each base's raw/ directory, processed to markdown (file processor / MinerU), chunked, embedded via AiService.embedMany (AI SDK) with dimension validation against base.dimensions, and stored in a per-base index.sqlite (better-sqlite3 + sqlite-vec) with a 7-table material model, external-content FTS5 trigram (fts_rowid surrogate key), brute-force cosine vector search, and RRF hybrid fusion. Four AI tools (kb_search, kb_list, kb_read, kb_manage) plus a Claude Code MCP bridge share one runtime-agnostic core (knowledgeLookup.ts). Base lifecycle, write-side orchestration, read-side query, and job-handler task flow are all implemented with per-base mutation locking (KeyedMutex) and lifecycle-service recovery.

findings.finding: Lifecycle facade (@Injectable('KnowledgeService'), Phase.WhenReady) registering 6 job handlers (copy-sources, prepare-root, index-documents, check-file-processing-result, delete-subtree, reindex-subtree) and delegating all public ops to baseAdmin/ingestionService/queryService/conceptService.
DependsOn ['KnowledgeVectorStoreService', 'JobManager', 'FileProcessingService', 'WebSearchService'] — cross-service lifecycle wiring correct per phase rules.
onInit registers handlers; onAllReady runs recoverDeletingItems + recoverInterruptedItems boot-time recovery.

addItems: conflict resolution (rename/detect/replace), raw/ path reservation under KeyedMutex, item creation, source copy scheduling via knowledge.copy-sources job. copyInline option for restore all-or-nothing.
deleteItems: sets subtree status to 'deleting' then enqueues knowledge.delete-subtree in one DbService.withWriteTx transaction.
reindexItems: asserts source reacquireability (classifyKnowledgeItemReacquireSource), asserts subtrees settled, enqueues one knowledge.reindex-subtree job per root item.
enableEmbeddingModel: configures embedding model on BM25-only base and backfills embeddings for completed leaves in one transaction, then schedules per-leaf indexing jobs.
listBasesForDiscovery delegates to knowledgeBaseService.listForDiscovery with scope, query, groupId, cursor, limit.

search: token gate (extractFtsTokens), mode selection (hybrid if completed vector base else bm25), query embedding via embedKnowledgeQuery, overfetch (5x, cap 200), store search, rerank, trimToTopK, applyRelevanceThreshold.
Constants KNOWLEDGE_SEARCH_OVERFETCH_FACTOR=5 and KNOWLEDGE_SEARCH_CANDIDATE_CAP=200 bound brute-force vector scan cost.
listItemChunks: reads material units from index store per leaf item, reconstructs KnowledgeItemChunk with tokenCount via estimateTokenCount.
getFilePath: resolves absolute on-disk source path for file/url items (preparing → data.source; completed → base file path).
Lifecycle service caching one KnowledgeIndexStore per base id; closes all on stop; getIndexStoreIfExists for cleanup on failed bases; deleteStore removes entire base dir.
reportInvisibleIndexContents: loud-failure diagnostic when an empty index mounts under a base with completed items (deleted/blanked index.sqlite detection).
rebuildMaterial: single BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction replacing all units for a material; content-by-hash dedup; unit + search_text insert; embedding insert with coverage check; orphan GC.
deleteMaterials: per-material short transactions with setImmediate yields every 50ms (DELETE_YIELD_BUDGET_MS) to avoid main-process freeze, then single collectIndexGarbage pass.
search: vector / bm25 / hybrid modes; hybrid fuses both lanes via fuseWithRrf (RRF_K=60, alpha default 0.5), prefetch = topK * 5.
vectorSearch: brute-force cosine scan over plain-BLOB embedding column via vec_distance_cosine; WHERE dist IS NOT NULL drops zero-norm vectors; no ANN index (documented limitation).
bm25Search: FTS5 MATCH path with trigram tokenizer + LIKE substring fallback (needsLikeFallback) for short/CJK terms; short-term filters relax when they eliminate all candidates.

KNOWLEDGE_INDEX_SCHEMA_VERSION=2; 7-table material model (meta, content, material, search_unit, search_text, embedding, search_text_fts) with external-content FTS5 trigram, fts_rowid surrogate key, ON DELETE CASCADE FKs.
FTS5 triggers (search_text_ai/ad/au) keep external-content index in sync; fts_rowid assigned via MAX(fts_rowid)+1 under per-base KeyedMutex serialization (race-free by construction).
Synchronous better-sqlite3 driver; busy_timeout=5000, synchronous=NORMAL, foreign_keys=ON, journal_mode=WAL; loads sqlite-vec extension via getLoadablePath/toAsarUnpackedPath.
vec_distance_cosine(column, ?) distance expression; query vector bound as raw LE float32 bytes matching stored encoding.
createKnowledgeIndexStoreAtPath: canonical open sequence (driver → version-aware schema → meta identity → store), close-on-throw, reset on version mismatch, afterOpen hook for diagnostics.
ensureIndexMeta stamps/verifies meta base_id identity row; refuses index.sqlite swapped from another base; readIndexSchemaVersion returns null for blank files.

embedKnowledgeQuery/embedKnowledgeTexts call AiService.embedMany (AI SDK) with uniqueModelId from base.embeddingModelId; assertEmbeddingVectors validates count, non-empty, and width === base.dimensions.

searchKnowledge: shared runtime-agnostic core for kb_search; scopes baseIds against allowedIds, never throws (returns {error} on all-bases-failed), dedupes by pageContent, clamps score to [0,1], tags with cite ids.
readConcept/grepConcept: deep-read modes; conceptLookupError distinguishes base-not-found (steer to kb_list) from content-missing (retry shortly) from bad conceptId.
manageKnowledge: add/delete/refresh/create; create NOT scoped to allowedIds (new base outside ceiling); all actions mutation-unconditional (caller gates approval).
listKnowledgeBases: bounded concurrency (PQueue, KB_LIST_ROOT_ITEMS_CONCURRENCY=8) for listRootItems per base; itemsUnavailable flag distinguishes read failure from empty base.

No ANN index: brute-force cosine scan over all embedding rows; O(N) per vector query. Documented as a current limitation (engine portability decision A1, technical-design §5.6).

Planned v2.x surface (material provenance relations, editable index entries, watcher-driven origins/states) NOT pre-created; adding a new table is zero-cost but changing an existing table requires bumping KNOWLEDGE_INDEX_SCHEMA_VERSION.
No AbortSignal/cancellation plumbing: KnowledgeService exposes no AbortSignal, so search/read/grep take no signal (unlike web core).

Indexing jobs declare recovery: 'abandon' — interrupted jobs are cancelled, never auto-resumed on next launch (deliberate: paid embedding API must not auto-spend). Boot-time recoverInterruptedItems only marks stranded items failed.
recoverDeletingItems: boot-time re-enqueue of delete-subtree jobs for stranded 'deleting' roots (recovery: 'retry' only for delete-subtree).
toVisibleSearchResults applies item-visibility filter (existence / base match / completed) to index matches; drops invisible units.
listMaterialUnits: INNER JOIN search_unit → search_text; missing body throws (store corruption) rather than fabricating empty result.
needsFileProcessing: only file items with base.fileProcessorId and no indexedRelativePath (or forceFileReprocess) go through the file processor; others index straight from source.
planRuntimeAddItemInput: url with snapshotPath → copy snapshot to raw/ and pin relativePath; file with indexedPath → copy processed artifact too; reserveArtifact for processed-md collision avoidance.
Orphan base artifact inspection/removal (stale index.sqlite dirs without a matching knowledge_base row).
purgeKnowledgeSubtreeWithinLock: purges subtree items under base lock (used by replace strategy and delete).
FileProcessingWaitManager: mirrors FileProcessingService task progress into per-(base,item) waits; used by scheduleItem for file processing flow.
markUnscheduledKnowledgeItemsFailed: marks items stranded after addItems scheduling failure as 'failed'.
resolveKnowledgeAddConflicts: conflict detection/resolution for add (rename/detect/replace strategies) against existing roots and batch-internal dedup.
cancelActiveKnowledgeJobs: cancels in-flight jobs touching conflicting subtrees before taking the base lock (avoids deadlock).
assertEmbeddingVectors: validates embedding count === input count, non-empty vectors, and width === base.dimensions; throws invalidOperation on mismatch.
Scope gating: targetIds = baseIds filtered by allowedIds (empty allowedIds = all bases); dropped baseIds logged as warn before empty-target early return.
kb_manage 'create' deliberately NOT scoped to allowedIds (new base outside ceiling); caller approves; AI-SDK path leaves binding to user, Claude Code bridge elevates into session scope.
No builtin tool runs with strict: true — Anthropic strict grammar budget would 400 requests when 4 kb_* tools bind at once; non-strict schemas serve both AI-SDK tools and MCP bridge.
fuseWithRrf: rank-based RRF (RRF_K=60), vector weight=alpha, bm25 weight=1-alpha; sidesteps incompatible cosine/BM25 score scales.
bm25LikeSearch: LIKE '%token%' fallback ranked by ascending body length (denser match first), exposed as higher-is-better score for hybrid fusion.
reclaimSpace: FTS 'optimize' pre-VACUUM step compacts dead trigram segments VACUUM can't reach; gated behind freelist threshold so small deletes never pay full-index merge.
rebuildMaterial unit id: computeUnitId(materialId, contentHash, unitType, unitIndex, charStart, charEnd) — stable per unit; content hash dedups across materials (decision A4).
Concept ID = material relative_path (OKF §2), used by kb_read/kb_manage for deep addressing.
readConcept/grepConcept/deleteConcepts/refreshConcepts/getOrganizationTree implement deep-read and mutation operations on concepts.

gaps: No ANN index: vector search is brute-force O(N) cosine over all embedding rows (KnowledgeIndexStore.ts:499). Acceptable for per-base indexes but will not scale to very large bases.
No AbortSignal/cancellation plumbing on search/read/grep (knowledgeLookup.ts:18-21) — long queries cannot be cancelled mid-flight.

strengths: Single shared runtime-agnostic core (knowledgeLookup.ts) powers all four AI tools plus the Claude Code MCP bridge with identical logic, error contracts, and scope gating.
Per-base mutation locking via KeyedMutex serializes multi-step invariants across main DB + index store + filesystem, preventing TOCTOU races.
Index store is a rebuildable derived artifact (schema resets on version mismatch; source of truth is knowledge_item + raw materials) — no in-place migration complexity.
External-content FTS5 trigram with fts_rowid surrogate key avoids the implicit-rowid desync bug (#16132 class) across VACUUM/rebuilds.
BM25 LIKE fallback + short-term relaxation handles short/CJK queries the trigram FTS can't index.
RRF rank-based fusion cleanly combines incompatible cosine and BM25 score scales.
DeleteMaterials yields to the OS message pump every 50ms to avoid main-process window freezes during bulk deletes.
Dimension validation (embed.ts:44-73) asserts vector width === base.dimensions and count matches inputs before any write.
Boot-time recovery: recoverInterruptedItems (abandon, never auto-spend paid embeddings) + recoverDeletingItems (retry delete-subtree).
Loud-failure diagnostics: empty-index store-open error (reportInvisibleIndexContents), meta base_id mismatch refusal, close-on-throw for failed opens (no leaked SQLite handles on Windows).
~87 test files across main, AI tools adapter, and renderer layers; vector-store tests run against real temp-dir SQLite.
Non-strict tool schemas by design (builtinTools.ts:22-50) avoids Anthropic strict-grammar 400s when 4 kb_* tools bind simultaneously.
All user-visible strings route through i18n (renderer) / shared schemas (main); no hardcoded UI strings in the knowledge domain.
weaknesses: Brute-force vector search (no ANN) caps per-base index scale.
No cancellation/AbortSignal on knowledge lookup operations.
Index store schema is not incrementally migratable — existing-table changes require a version bump and full rebuild (acceptable for derived artifact, but a constraint to remember).

The `search_text.fts_rowid` assignment via MAX()+1 is race-free only because all writes to a base's index are serialized upstream by KeyedMutex — the driver itself does not self-check lock ownership (documented TODO in BetterSqlite3Driver.ts:55-58).

embeddingPipeline: Sources → Readers → Indexing → VectorStore. (1) Sources: directory expansion (prepare-root), URL fetch via Jina reader (KnowledgeSnapshotReader), file snapshots, notes (sourcePlanning.ts). Raw bytes land in {baseDir}/raw/. (2) Readers: file→markdown (KnowledgeFileReader), pdf/docx/epub via MinerU/PaddleOCR out-of-process (DocReader/EpubReader/AnydocReader/DraftsExportReader). (3) Indexing: chunk (structure-aware markdown chunking with offset preservation, chunk.ts/splitter.ts/tokenLimit.ts), embed (AiService.embedMany via AI SDK with dimension validation against base.dimensions, embed.ts), rerank (AiService.rerank with persistent-misconfig detection on 401/403/404, rerank.ts). (4) VectorStore: per-base index.sqlite at {baseDir}/.cherry/index.sqlite (better-sqlite3 + sqlite-vec); 7-table material model (meta/content/material/search_unit/search_text/embedding/search_text_fts), external-content FTS5 trigram with fts_rowid surrogate key (schema.ts), brute-force cosine over plain-BLOB float32 vectors (BetterSqlite3VectorIndex.ts), BM25 MATCH + LIKE fallback (KnowledgeIndexStore.ts:521-592), RRF hybrid fusion (RRF_K=60, alpha=0.5, fuseWithRrf at line 656). Per-base KeyedMutex serializes all mutations; KnowledgeVectorStoreService caches one store per base and closes all on stop.
schemaCoverage: Main DB: knowledgeBaseTable + knowledgeItemTable in src/main/data/db/schemas/knowledge.ts with CHECK constraints (type/status per-type combinations, model/dimensions pairing, status/error pairing). Shared types: src/shared/data/types/knowledge.ts (zod contracts for KnowledgeBase, KnowledgeItem, KnowledgeSearchResult, KnowledgeAddItemInput, conflict strategies, status/error codes). Per-base index.sqlite: 7 tables — meta (schema_version, base_id, timestamps), content (content_hash PK, text, created_at), material (material_id PK, relative_path UNIQUE + traversal guards, current_content_hash FK), search_unit (unit_id PK, material_id FK CASCADE, unit_type CHECK 'chunk', unit_index, char_start/end, content_hash FK CASCADE), search_text (search_text_id PK, target_type/kind CHECKs, text, embedding_text_hash, fts_rowid surrogate), embedding (embedding_text_hash PK, vector_blob BLOB LE float32, created_at), search_text_fts (external-content FTS5 over search_text.text, trigram tokenizer, content_rowid='fts_rowid'). FTS5 triggers (ai/ad/au) keep the external-content index in sync. KNOWLEDGE_INDEX_SCHEMA_VERSION=2; version mismatch → drop+recreate (derived artifact, no in-place migration). Concept ID = material.relative_path (OKF §2).
